data: S&P500 from the cited ESTIMATE release

paper_specified.loss: return MSE plus sum of all pairwise ranking hinges

reconstruction_choices.cross_scale_softmax: column normalized as written in Eq.18; literal B@E in Eq.19

portfolio.name: dollar_neutral_top_bottom_equal_weight
portfolio.selection: highest top_k scores long; lowest top_k scores short; disjoint books
portfolio.small_universe: use min(top_k, valid_stocks//2) stocks on each side
portfolio.ties: stable descending score order, then stored ticker order; bottom book uses the end of the same ordering
portfolio.cost_convention: buys only: long purchases and short covers; sells and new shorts free
portfolio.cost_turnover: actual traded dollars after drift; initial entry and final liquidation included
portfolio.position_drift: price returns mark holdings; total returns determine P&L when supplied
portfolio.definition: dollar neutrality at each daily rebalance; beta neutrality is not imposed

reconstruction_choices.annualization: gross and net SR use sqrt(252); paper portfolio convention is unverified, so SR is not directly comparable
reconstruction_choices.loss_sensitivity: also run mean pairwise hinge, as in the cited StockMixer code; not mixed with main results
